fields.description: Public Central URL used as the RSA token issuer and to build the Pilot public-key URL. Leave blank to use the site URL. Atlas tokens use the fixed issuer central.
fields.label: Central Public URL

fields.description: Identifies the RSA key used for Pilot and service tokens. Published with the public key.
fields.label: RSA Key ID

fields.description: PEM public key benches verify Central-minted tokens against. Published (as a JWK) at the JWKS endpoint.
fields.label: RSA Public Key (PEM)

fields.description: PEM private key Central signs with. Encrypted at rest; never leaves Central.
fields.label: RSA Private Key (PEM)

fields.description: Ed25519 key for regional Atlas requests. Initialize once before configuring Atlas trust.
fields.label: Atlas Signing Key (Ed25519)

fields.description: Public key identifier in the central: namespace.
fields.label: Atlas Key ID

fields.description: Public Ed25519 verification key published for Atlas.
fields.label: Atlas Public Key (Ed25519 PEM)

fields.description: Encrypted signing key. Never sent to Atlas.
fields.label: Atlas Private Key (Ed25519 PEM)
